NOTE on these '//' keys: JSON has no comments, so they are ordinary keys
that nothing binds to. They are safe at the ROOT of the file and inside
sections bound to our own option classes, which ignore unknown keys. Do NOT
put one inside Logging:LogLevel - every key there is parsed as a log level,
and an unparseable one stops the application from starting.
A DEVELOPMENT-ONLY signing key, committed deliberately so a fresh clone
runs. Program.cs REFUSES TO START outside Development if it sees the
DEVELOPMENT-ONLY marker in this string, because anyone reading this
repository could otherwise mint themselves an Admin token.
Generate your own for anything real:  openssl rand -base64 48
